{{Top|leg}}
The '''Maw colony''' was a colony established by former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] following the destruction of the old [[Maw Installation]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]. It was located in the cluster of [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]] called [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. [[Rhondi Tremaine|Rhondi]] and [[Rolund Tremaine]] were born in this colony.
